verdict.rationale: Revenue recognition is a fair question for a subscription billing and monetization platform like RevenueCat, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only subscription metrics charts, MRR analysis and scheduled raw-data exports. Nothing documents ASC 606 / IFRS 15 recognition, deferred revenue schedules, or audit-ready recognition reports, and data exports are only an adjacent building block a finance team would have to process elsewhere.

support.subject: As a finance lead, revenue is recognized on an ASC 606 / IFRS 15 basis — deferred revenue schedules and audit-ready recognition reports straight from billing data
